desc:
The monsters from 99 Nights have gotten lost all around the map — can you find them all? Explore, discover secrets, and collect every unique morph before your friends do!

✨ Unlock rare morphs, complete your collection, and uncover hidden Easter eggs!
💬 New updates every week — more morphs, more secrets, more chaos!

👀 Tip: Don’t forget to leave a like 👍 and share your feedback after playing — it helps a lot!
